what: A two-word title stands at both ends of the section, joined by a line .125× the font size in thickness. When the title reaches the 85% line of the screen the line unfolds from the center to both sides in 1.5s (curve .4,0,0,1), and .1s later the words rise from 100% below over 1s while turning on (.1s apart). Scrolling back up folds it in reverse

options.dur: Duration of the line spreading (sec), default 1.5
options.once: If true, it won’t fold back when reversed
options.--fx-color · --fx-thick · --fx-gap: Line color·thickness·gap between word and line (via style), defaults var(--kf-accent) · .125em · .33em
options.[data-fx-part=word]: Words at both ends (children, usually two)

from.where: shared.css .t-title (section header · page header · next-section band — yellow line .75em · 6em title)
